verdict.rationale: Identity Resolution writes unified identities and a one-row-per-identity Golden Record into your warehouse, which you can 'query directly'. Hightouch Events also lands behavioral event data in the warehouse, and Customer Studio builds traits on top. The docs say plainly that profile storage and serving move to your own warehouse rather than a Hightouch-hosted profile store, and the REST API covers syncs, models, sources and destinations, not profile lookups. missing for 10: a documented profile lookup API for traits, identifiers and event history; documentation of a unified per-profile schema joining traits, identifiers and events; independent or hands-on corroboration.
